create_fakify: create a fake tensor from a real tensor given a fake mode, tensor, constraints, and source
build_fake_tree: build fake tensors recursively from nested structures of lists, dicts, and tensors
create_make_fake_inputs: create a fake mode and fake inputs from an nn module, example inputs, and shape constraints
test_make_constraints: test constraint solving and guard production from a fake mode, source equalities, and graph module
review_make_constraints: review the make_constraints function that produces guards, solves dim constraints, and returns range and equality constraints
